svg.title: SUES-200: UAV 300 m → satellite: selective risk and coverage
svg.desc: Three seeds shown separately. Sixty native observed points at actual selected-count coverage. Connecting lines are visual guides, not complete all-prefix curves. Saved AURC uses all prefixes. No CI or significance. Margin is not a calibrated posterior.
svg.text: Selective risk by margin-ranked coverage; N = 4,000 queries
Selective risk = 1 − R@1 among selected queries (%)
Selection: top k = ceil(requested coverage × N), ranked by raw cosine Top-1 margin.
Margin is not a calibrated probability. Ties retain the source query order.
Points: ten registered coverage levels; connecting segments are visual guides only.
Seeds and tasks stay separate. No CI or significance shown; AURC uses all prefixes.
